One table of indicator_change() as a DataTable

Source: R/fct_change.R
render_change_table.Rd

As in golemworldbank: the values of the two years and the change to 3 significant digits (6.02M, 1.42B, 0.0752), while sorting still uses the full numbers, and the percent change with one decimal, in bold green for an increase and red for a decrease, on one long page with compact rows (by their padding: golemworldbank's line height of 80% would make the long names of Eurostat's indicators, on two lines, run into each other).

Usage

render_change_table(tab)

Arguments

tab

One of the data frames of indicator_change(), increased or decreased.

Value

A DT table.

Examples

render_change_table(indicator_change("EL", 2015, 2024)$increased)
